scope: Immutable original GetUp/IDLE selection rules over caller-supplied ordered model banks and a finite forest. Not a winning-record link reconstruction or a running recovery owner.
rules: Model key uses first exact case-sensitive IdleAnims substring anywhere, otherwise last backslash directory plus IdleAnims; forward slashes remain distinct. ASCII C-string models shorter than260 bytes; bytes after first NUL are unconsumed.
Bank equality folds ASCII case while retaining separators. Derived bank keys can exceed259 bytes; original259-byte input produces268-byte key.

Filename predicate tests only final extension .kf case-insensitively, including an empty basename; no VFS/resource existence check or skeleton-directory filter. ANAM low7 bits do not filter selection.
Prune Deleted records before conditions, then false parents before children. Optional flag bypasses initial filename predicate. Descendants precede parent fallback in declared child order.
First optional no-file fallback stops later roots; outer postcheck repeats filename query only if selected record currently has optional bit. Nonoptional fallback does not re-read filename.
Validate unique typed record IDs, child indices, finite acyclic single-parent forest, root indices and unique case-folded bank keys. Records are borrowed and must remain alive/current.
engineering_cases: Deleted/false/optional branch suppression of unused invalid filenames
Retry after failed condition adapter without changing index
Iterative10000-node traversal; this is adapter robustness, not original10000-node gameplay evidence
read_consumption_probe: Child-condition boundary optionally changes parent filename/optional flag; original instructions determine query timing. No claim that ordinary CTDA mutates these fields in gameplay.

Current C++ selector does not construct those banks or implement load/override/deletion lifecycle.
